ConceptDef.label: EcoTech: Mutating Plants
ConceptDef.helpText: You can mutate specific Terratech plants by using terrasaps. Mutating plants causes them to produce different results when they finish growing! \nWhile the plant is growing, use the "Infuse" sap option to mutate the plant. Each sap infusion is unique, so experiment!

ConceptDef.label: EcoTech: Terrasaps
ConceptDef.helpText: Terrasaps are a key aspect of EcoTech. Several types exist, with different effects, rarities, and importance depending on the terratech path you're progressing. Generally you'll have easy access to basic saps, such as glowsap or shocksap, but as you progress you can acquire stronger saps. These stronger saps can be used to mutating organic weapons and plants, evolving lithic items, catalyzing powerful structures, further refinement, and so on. Every terrasap has a unique effect and varying potency. Both are noted in a terrasap's description, so be sure to check each one!

ConceptDef.label: EcoTech: Organic Crafting
ConceptDef.helpText: While many plants are simple and passively produce resources, manual organic crafting relies on two main structures; the terravat, and the biomeld tree. You'll want to be familiar with both of these. Terravats accepts large amounts of a single sap type, and multiple items, and will combine both every so often. The combination will produce mutated items, or can renourish the items inside. This is especially helpful for making sure withering weapons don't die off. Biomeld Trees are more intricate, and require a variety of items to produce one final product. Generally the output is much more specific, but takes more resources and time. Even though these two are the most important, other plants may produce resources as well. Keep an eye out!

ConceptDef.label: EcoTech: Mutation Potential
ConceptDef.helpText:
Various organic terratech creations have different mutation potentials. Which can be summarized as follows: 
BOUNDLESS: Capable of undergoing mutation at the atomic level (total transformation, resulting in a new creation entirely). 
HIGH: Capable of undergoing mutation at the cellular level (selectively adding or removing biofunctions). 
MEDIUM: Capable of mutations affecting it's current biological functions (rewriting biofunctions). 
LOW: Capable of basic mutation (enforcing existing biofunctions - negative and positive). 
NONE: Incapable of mutation. 
ERRATIC: Results that can end up being anything, or don't fall into the other categories. 
The higher the potential, the stronger of a terrasap you can apply.
